lpc.note: Liberated Pixel Cup characters (2,755 files): bodies, hair, clothes, walk cycles. Attribution + share-alike required.

kenney.note: The COMPLETE Kenney asset pack (~5,000 files): sprites, tilesets, UI, props, fish (fishSwim/fishPink/fishGreen), tile backgrounds. Zero restrictions — safe for commercial videos.

kenney-particles.note: Kenney particle textures (smoke, dust, fire, sparkles) — perfect for ae-motion impact scenes.

kenney-textures.note: Kenney prototype textures (grass, stone, wood patterns) — hand-drawn background fills.

kenney-ui-sounds.note: Kenney UI sound effects (clicks, pops, alerts) — free SFX for transitions.

game-icons.credit: One line in the video description: 'Icons by game-icons.net (Lorc, Delapouite and contributors), CC BY 3.0'.
game-icons.note: 4,283 sketchy HAND-DRAWN icons: angler-fish, clownfish, giant-squid, shark-fin, sperm-whale, creatures, weapons, buildings, symbols. SVG — fetch with --rasterize to get a PNG.

fluent-emoji.note: Microsoft Fluent emoji (27,000 files): flat bold colors with dark outlines — a doodle-like look. 3D/*.png files are ready PNGs (fish, crab, whale, octopus, animals, objects); Flat/*.svg need --rasterize.

humaaans.credit: One line in the video description: 'People by Pablo Stanley (humaaans.com), CC BY 4.0'.
humaaans.note: 253 flat hand-drawn people — mix & match standing/sitting/arms/legs, PNG + @2x. The closest asset equivalent of stick-figure characters.

open-peeps.note: Hand-drawn people PARTS (bodies, hair, faces, beards, accessories) to mix & match into characters. SVG — fetch with --rasterize.

openclipart.note: 36,000+ public-domain clipart SVGs sorted by category (animals, food, scenery, people...). Some files messy/duplicated — pick by filename. SVG — fetch with --rasterize.

twemoji.credit: One line in the video description: 'Emoji by Twemoji, CC BY 4.0'.
twemoji.note: 7,400+ flat emoji: assets/72x72/<code>.png (ready PNG) and assets/svg/<code>.svg. Files are named by EMOJI CODEPOINT: fish=1f41f, shark=1f988, octopus=1f419, whale=1f40b, crab=1f980, dragon=1f409, owl=1f989, dolphin=1f42c, turtle=1f422.

fxemoji.credit: One line in the video description: 'Emoji by Mozilla fxemoji, CC BY 4.0'.
fxemoji.note: 11,800+ flat emoji with bold outlines — the most doodle-like emoji set. svgs/FirefoxEmoji/u1F41F-fish.svg (search by name works here: fish, shark, whale...). SVG — fetch with --rasterize.

openmoji.credit: One line in the video description: 'Emoji by OpenMoji, CC BY-SA 4.0'.
openmoji.note: 30,000 files, high-quality open emoji: color/618x618/<CODE>.png ready PNGs + black/svg outlines. Codepoint names (fish=1F41F, shark=1F988, octopus=1F419, dragon=1F409). Share-alike: fine in videos with the credit line.

noto-emoji.note: 20,000 files, Google's emoji: png/512/emoji_u1f41f.png (ready PNG) + svg. Codepoint names (fish=emoji_u1f41f). Credit 'Noto Emoji, Google' in the description.

tabler-icons.note: 6,100+ outline stroke icons (icons/outline/*.svg + filled). Stroke line-art fits hand-drawn diagrams, arrows, labels. SVG — fetch with --rasterize.

feather.note: 280 minimal stroke icons (icons/*.svg) — clean line drawings for diagrams. SVG — fetch with --rasterize.

phosphor.note: 18,000 icons in 6 weights (assets/bold|regular|thin|duotone|fill|light/*.svg). Regular/light look hand-sketched. SVG — fetch with --rasterize.

bootstrap-icons.note: 4,200+ icons (icons/*.svg), filled line style. Good for UI-ish labels and markers. SVG — fetch with --rasterize.

font-awesome.credit: One line in the video description: 'Icons by Font Awesome, CC BY 4.0'.
font-awesome.note: 2,000+ free icons in js-packages/@fortawesome/fontawesome-free/svgs/{solid,regular,brands}/*.svg. SVG — fetch with --rasterize.

simple-icons.note: 3,500+ brand logos (icons/youtube.svg, icons/google.svg...) — for thumbnails, channel art, 'find us on' end cards. SVG — fetch with --rasterize.

dungeontileset-0x72.note: HAND-DRAWN PIXEL BACKGROUNDS: dungeon walls, floors, doors, chests, props — atlases + individual frames under public/sprites/0x72_DungeonTilesetII_v1.7/. Fetch the atlas PNGs or single frame files.

pixel-adventure.credit: Optional credit: 'Art by Pixel Frog (Pixel Adventure)'.
pixel-adventure.note: HAND-DRAWN PIXEL SCENES: 'Assets/Pixel Adventure 1/Assets/' — terrain tiles (build any scene), characters (Mask Dude, Pink Man, Ninja Frog, Virtual Guy — idle/run/jump frames), enemies, items, doors. Full platformer world in flat bright colors.
